purpose: Validate whether the four descriptive redistribution-result quadrants persist across entry cohorts
classification: sign of cohort nextHHI-entryHHI and sign of nextHHI-exact matched reference expectation
common_sample: at least100 paired domestic continuations in each cohort; threshold500 as sensitivity
no_optimization: do not alter axes, cutoffs or cohort windows after inspecting stability
caution: types use outcome quantities, so their HHI differences cannot validate them; cohort calendar follow-up overlaps
